Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the context and the usage file. We're looking at two practical options to cover the 10-day window without impacting latency:

Option A — Burst Top-up (fastest):
- Add temporary burst capacity for 14 days.
- Rate: $0.0125 / 1K tokens for additional burst tokens (over existing quota).
- Billed pro rata for days used; no change to committed capacity.
- No setup fee.

Option B — Short-term Reserved (recommended if you expect repeated spikes):
- 1-month reserved add-on (cancelable end of month).
- Rate: $0.0100 / 1K tokens (lower unit cost) + one-time provisioning buffer.
- Prorated credit if upgraded to annual commit later.

Regarding credits/discounts: we can offer a one-time usage credit equal to 10% of the billed burst amount if you sign an addendum for Q4 annual commit discussions within 30 days. Dylan, could you confirm approval for the 10% credit?

If that works, I can send a short addendum and the DocuSign link.

Notes: the burst option uses isolated GPU pools to preserve your latency SLOs; we will route requests to the burst pool automatically.

– Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
